description: Scan an AI agent repo for security issues before merge or deploy: secrets, prompt injection and hidden Unicode in agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, SKILL.md), unpinned or poisoned MCP servers, inline MCP secrets, lethal-trifecta toolsets and risky CI/package/Docker commands. Returns pass/fail, findings with file and line, optional SARIF. Paid x402 $0.01 USDC on Base per run (up to 200 files, 1 MB).

fail_on.description: Fail on block findings (default) or review findings too

sarif.description: Also return SARIF 2.1.0 for GitHub code scanning

name: shipcheck_scan
